gaps: Counts is null: company totals by numerical phase were not verified; the pipeline chart was not manually counted.
Origins were not verified for zanubrutinib, tislelizumab, tacabrutideg, BGB-43395, BGB-B2033, BGB-58067 or BG-C477.

The pipeline identifies DualityBio collaboration for BG-C9074 and Zymeworks/Jazz collaboration for zanidatamab; co-developed records this collaboration, not unrestricted worldwide commercial ownership.
BGB-B2033 remains phase 2 here: the chart lists Phase 3 but flags the study as potentially not yet enrolling, and Q3 results still forecast its initiation in Q4.
Sonrotoclax/BEQALZI is excluded: it is already marketed in MCL and the pending EU MCL application is a geographic filing, not a verified major new indication.

Zanidatamab's next milestone and tacabrutideg's phase 3 are corroborated by the Q3 release and November pipeline, respectively. Tacabrutideg timing is mid-2027; when uses 2027 because no exact quarter or half-year was disclosed.
Readout dates for BGB-43395, BG-C9074 and BGB-58067 were not disclosed in the sources read; next is null. Development codes not explicitly verified are null.

URL validation: the prescribed curl -sSIL check was attempted for every listed source URL; all returned HTTP 000 / curl error 6 (DNS resolution unavailable in the shell). These URLs were opened with the live web tool, but final HTTP HEAD status could not be independently verified.
